# europetaxi24

> europetaxi24 is a taxi and airport transfer service based in Zaventem, Belgium, operated by CAN COMPANY (VAT BE 1016.219.906). Every ride has a price fixed in advance: a base fare of €10 plus €1.99 per kilometre. The service runs 24/7 across Belgium and to Germany, France, Luxembourg and the Netherlands. The website is available in French (Belgium), Dutch (Belgium), English and Turkish.

Last updated: 2026-10-12. Currency: EUR. Website: https://europetaxi24.be

## Website (one page per language)
- [English](https://europetaxi24.be/en/): booking form, prices, fleet, FAQ and legal information in English.
- [Français (Belgique)](https://europetaxi24.be/fr/): booking form, prices, fleet, FAQ and legal information in French (Belgium). Default language of the site (x-default).
- [Nederlands (België)](https://europetaxi24.be/nl/): booking form, prices, fleet, FAQ and legal information in Dutch (Belgium).
- [Türkçe](https://europetaxi24.be/tr/): booking form, prices, fleet, FAQ and legal information in Turkish.

## Services
- Airport transfers: Brussels Airport (Zaventem), Charleroi Airport (CRL), Antwerp Airport (ANR), Ostend-Bruges Airport (OST), Liège Airport (LGG), Amsterdam Schiphol (AMS), Eindhoven Airport (EIN), Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG), Paris Orly (ORY), Cologne/Bonn Airport (CGN), Düsseldorf Airport (DUS), Frankfurt Airport (FRA), Luxembourg Airport (LUX).
- Intercity taxi rides between Belgian cities (for example Brussels, Antwerp, Ghent, Bruges, Leuven, Liège, Namur, Mons, Hasselt, Mechelen, Kortrijk, Ostend).
- Cross-border rides to Germany, France, Luxembourg and the Netherlands (for example Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Eindhoven, Maastricht, Paris, Lille, Cologne, Düsseldorf, Aachen, Luxembourg).
- Return trips: a return date and time can be added when booking.
- Booking: the online form on each language page ([English booking form](https://europetaxi24.be/en/#rezervasyon)) or WhatsApp (https://wa.me/32493839898).

## Pricing
- Formula: total price = €10 base fare + €1.99 per kilometre driven.
- The price shown at booking is final. There is no night or weekend surcharge.
- Airport flat rate: for airports a fixed airport price is also offered; today's price can be requested on WhatsApp (https://wa.me/32493839898).
- Deposit: 20% is paid online at booking (Bancontact, credit card or Apple Pay, processed by Mollie). The balance is paid to the driver, in cash or by card.
- Example prices from the formula (distance in road km, prices in EUR, deposit 20%):

| Route | Distance | Total price | Deposit online | Balance to driver |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Brussels → Brussels Airport (Zaventem) | 13 km | €35.87 | €7.17 | €28.70 |
| Brussels → Charleroi Airport (CRL) | 55 km | €119.45 | €23.89 | €95.56 |
| Ghent → Brussels Airport (Zaventem) | 56 km | €121.44 | €24.29 | €97.15 |
| Antwerp → Brussels Airport (Zaventem) | 37 km | €83.63 | €16.73 | €66.90 |
| Brussels → Antwerp | 45 km | €99.55 | €19.91 | €79.64 |
| Brussels → Ghent | 56 km | €121.44 | €24.29 | €97.15 |
| Brussels → Amsterdam Schiphol (AMS) | 193 km | €394.07 | €78.81 | €315.26 |
| Brussels → Paris | 315 km | €636.85 | €127.37 | €509.48 |
| Bruges → Brussels Airport (Zaventem) | 107 km | €222.93 | €44.59 | €178.34 |
| Liège → Brussels Airport (Zaventem) | 90 km | €189.10 | €37.82 | €151.28 |

## Waiting time and cancellation
- Airports: waiting is free for 60 minutes after landing.
- Other addresses: the first 15 minutes are free, then €0.50 per minute.
- Cancellation more than 24 hours before departure: the deposit is fully refunded.
- Cancellation less than 24 hours before departure: the deposit is not refunded.

## Fleet
- Economy: Tesla Model 3 (4 passengers · 2 large + 2 small bags)
- Station Wagon: Extra-large boot (4 passengers · 4 large + 2 small bags)
- Business / VIP Van: Mercedes Vito (7 passengers · 6 large + 4 small bags)

- Opening hours: every day, 24 hours a day.

## Frequently asked questions (summary)
- How is the price calculated? A base fare of €10 plus €1.99 per kilometre driven. The price shown at booking is final: no night or weekend surcharges.
- How does payment work? You pay a 20% deposit online via Bancontact, credit card or Apple Pay (secured by Mollie). The rest is paid to the driver, in cash or by card.
- Can I cancel my booking? Yes. Cancel more than 24 hours before departure and the deposit is fully refunded. Within 24 hours of departure, the deposit is non-refundable.
- What if my flight is delayed? At airports, waiting is free for 60 minutes after landing. At other addresses, the first 15 minutes are free, then 0.50 € per minute.
- Do you drive abroad? Yes: Germany, France, Luxembourg and the Netherlands. Paris, Amsterdam, Cologne or Schiphol, the price is calculated the same way.
- How many passengers and bags fit? Up to 7 passengers and 6 large suitcases in our Mercedes Vito. For 4 passengers or fewer, the Tesla Model 3 or the station wagon is plenty.
- How much is a taxi from Brussels to Brussels Airport (Zaventem, BRU)? From central Brussels to Brussels Airport (Zaventem), the airport transfer is about 13 km, so €35.87 at the per-kilometre rate (€10 + €1.99 per km). From Ghent (about 56 km) it is €121.44. The price confirmed at booking is final; for the fixed airport price, ask for today's price on WhatsApp. Pay a 20% deposit online and the rest to the driver.
- How much is a taxi from Brussels to Charleroi Airport (CRL)? From Brussels to Charleroi Airport it is about 55 km, so €119.45 at the per-kilometre rate (€10 + €1.99 per km). The price confirmed at booking is final. At the airport, waiting is free for 60 minutes after landing.
- Do you drive at night and early in the morning? Yes, we are available every day, 24 hours a day, including for early flights and late arrivals. There is no night or weekend surcharge: the price confirmed at booking does not change.
- How much is a cross-border taxi from Brussels to Paris or Amsterdam? We drive to Germany, France, Luxembourg and the Netherlands with the same formula (€10 + €1.99 per km). From Brussels: Amsterdam Schiphol is about 193 km, so €394.07; Paris is about 315 km, so €636.85. The exact price is shown before you book.
